articleTitle: Heterogeneously integrated InP/SOI laser using double tapered single-mode waveguides through adhesive die to wafer bonding
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: An InP/Silicon hybrid laser based on double taper adiabatic mode transfer and BCB bonding is demonstrated, exhibiting nearly 1 mW output power at room temperature in pulsed operation regime. Such a laser enables potentially a low threshold current and a high power conversion efficiency.

articleTitle: Bulk silicon photonic wire for one-chip integrated optical interconnection
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report a nano-sized silicon waveguide by forming partial silicon-on-insulator structure with SPE on bulk silicon substrate. The propagation loss is as low as 6.1 dB/cm, which is close to that of silicon-on-insulator based waveguide.

articleTitle: Photonics and electronics integration in the HELIOS project
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: The objective of the European project HELIOS is to combine a photonic layer with a CMOS circuit by different innovative means, using microelectronics processes. Bonding of AWG + Ge Photodiodes on CMOS wafer is achieved.

articleTitle: Mach-Zehnder silicon modulator on bulk silicon substrate; toward DRAM optical interface
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We present a Mach-Zehnder silicon modulator fabricated on a bulk silicon substrate featuring active length of 200 µm, modulation speed up to 5 Gb/s, power consumption of 2 pJ/bit, and extinction ratio of 10 dB.

articleTitle: Fabrication variations in SOI microrings for DWDM networks
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We present a statistical analysis of fabrications defects in microring resonators fabricated using 248 nm lithography. We measure the scatter of the resonators' quality factor, extinction ratio, and resonant wavelength and how they influence DWDM networks.

articleTitle: Silicon high-speed electro-optic modulator
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A 40 Gbit/s electro-optic modulator is demonstrated. The modulator is based on a slotted silicon waveguide filled with a nonlinear organic material. A modulation voltage-length product of V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</sub>L = 0.21 Vcm can be achieved.

articleTitle: Optical frequency shifter on SOI using thermo-optic serrodyne modulation
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: An optical frequency shifter on SOI using thermo-optic serrodyne modulation is fabricated. It creates a 1 kHz frequency shift in 1550 nm laser, with a second-order harmonic sideband suppression of -38.5 dB.

articleTitle: Franz-Keldysh effect in germanium p-i-n photodetectors on silicon
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Ge on Si p-i-n photodetectors were grown by molecular beam epitaxy minimizing tensile strain. The slope of the absorption curve changes by a factor of 2 under varying voltages due to the clearly observable Franz-Keldysh-Effect.

articleTitle: Two-photon-absorption-based optical power monitor in silicon rib waveguides
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Utilizing two-photon-absorption effect, we demonstrate an in-situ scheme for monitoring optical power using p-i-n diode in silicon rib-waveguides for integrated photonics circuits. We show that a responsivity of 5.9μA/mW<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> can be reached with 15V reverse-bias for the square-law detector. An example of using such detectors for accurate waveguide propagation loss measurements is given.

articleTitle: Free charge carrier induced refractive index modulation of crystalline silicon
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: New relationships for the free carrier induced refractive index modulation of crystalline silicon at 1.3 and 1.55 μm are derived. Free electrons are more effective in perturbing the refractive index compared to free holes.

articleTitle: Waveguides for mid-infrared group IV photonics
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: In this paper we present preliminary work on group IV photonic waveguides that may be suitable for mid-infrared wavelengths. Fabrication and experimental results for two waveguide structures are given.

articleTitle: Integration of optical devices based on Si, Ge and SiOx
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Monolithic integration of various kinds of optical components on a silicon wafer is the key to making silicon photonics practical technology. Applying silicon (Si) photonics to telecommunications further requires low insertion loss and polarization independence. We demonstrate monolithic integration of Si variable optical attenuators, germanium photodiodes, a SiOx-based arrayed waveguide grating filter, and a spot size converter that connects each component with low loss. Moreover, We also show a method for achieving low polarization dependent loss in a Si-VOA. Our results indicate the great potential of silicon photonics technology for optical devices in telecommunications.

articleTitle: Polarization characteristics of low-loss nano-core buried optical waveguides and directional couplers
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: The characteristics of a low loss buried optical waveguide with a nano-core-layer of SiN is analyzed. With such a low-loss optical waveguide, directional couplers are also designed, fabricated and characterized.

articleTitle: Silicon based solar cells: Research progress and future perspectives
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A great number of new concepts and materials are still in the research stage. Some of them may lead to much higher efficiency and lower cost in the coming decade of silicon based solar cells Costs of crystalline silicon PV modules can be brought down to 1 euro/Wp combining technology developments, economies of scale and using solar grade feedstock. Silicon based solar cells with energy conversion efficiency of 40% will no longer be a dream and both medium and long term perspective of PV appears bright.

articleTitle: Design of strain-free GeSn/SiGeSn quantum-well electroabsorption modulators at 1550 nm wavelength
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We propose and analyze a strain-free GeSn/SiGeSn quantum-well structure for electroabsorption modulators based on the quantum-confined Stark effect at 1550 nm wavelength.

articleTitle: Optical gain from luminescent a-SiNxOy waveguide
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report the optical gain from a-SiN<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">y</sub> strip-loaded waveguide. The optical gain of 46cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> at 525 nm has been determined under top-pumping with He-Cd laser. The luminescent and gain mechanism is mainly attributed to the O-Si-N bond related radiative state.

articleTitle: Single strand DNA hybridization sensing using photonic crystal waveguide based sensor
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report an experimental demonstration of single-strand DNA detection at room temperature using a photonic crystal waveguide based optical sensor. A detection limit of 19.8nM is obtained.

articleTitle: High efficiency broadband polarization rotator on silicon-on-insulator
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate a polarization rotator fabricated using a 4 etch-step CMOS-compatible process including layer depositions on a silicon-on-insulator wafer by means of 193nm deep UV lithography. The measured polarization rotation efficiency is at least -0.5dB over a wavelength range of 80nm around 1550nm.

articleTitle: Practical integration method of active devices on SOI photonic integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We propose a method of mounting LD chips on SOI substrate and discuss about the optical coupling loss between LDs and Si photonic-wire waveguides. In our scheme, light output from an LD is coupled to the optical waveguides through spot-size-converters (SSC). The simulations show that a minimum optical coupling loss of 1.6 dB and an offset tolerance of ±0.7 μm for the LD chip positioning can be achieved. We measured the optical coupling loss, confirming the validity of the simulations.

articleTitle: Design of plasmon waveguide with strong field confinement and low loss for nonlinearity enhancement
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We propose a new hybrid dielectric and plasmonic waveguide offering an ultra high nonlinear coefficient γ = 4.7 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup> W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> which is 4 orders larger than conventional silicon waveguide with a propagation loss of 0.036 dB/μm.

articleTitle: Detection of lead contamination of water and VOC contamination of air using SOI micro-optical devices
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Micro-photonic SOI Mach-Zehnder interferometers were coated with solid-phase micro-extraction materials derived from polydimethylsiloxane to enable sensing of volatile organic compounds of the BTEX class in air. A different coating based on functionalized mesoporous silicates is used to detect lead Pb(II) with a detection limit of <;; 100 ppb in water.

articleTitle: Propagation loss of amorphous silicon optical waveguides at the 0.8 µm-wavelength range
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We fabricated optical waveguides using amorphous silicon deposited by catalytic chemical vapor deposition method. The waveguides were fabricated by photolithography and wet chemical etching. The propagation loss of 15 dB/cm at 830 nm was measured.

articleTitle: Hybrid-integrated silicon photonic circuit with an InGaAs photodetetor
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Flip-chip bonding and grating-assisted coupling techniques are proposed to integrate silicon photonic circuit with an InGaAs photodetector. Coupler-to-photodetector coupling efficiency of ~4 dB and data transmission of 1 Gbps are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Direct demonstration of sensitization at 980nm optical excitation in erbium-ytterbium silicates
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Sensitization of erbium by ytterbium in Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>Yb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-x</sub>SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> thin films at 980nm optical excitation is demonstrated by means of comparison of the 1.54μm photoluminescence intensities excited with 488nm and 980nm light. Additionally, it is shown that detrimental Er-Er interactions such as concentration quenching increase non-radiative decay rates at high erbium concentrations. Dilution of erbium by ytterbium reduces these interactions, leading to an increase of internal quantum efficiency.

articleTitle: Reduction of hybrid silicon laser thermal impedance using poly Si thermal shunts
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We present a hybrid silicon evanescent laser that uses poly-silicon thermal shunts to improve the 800μm long device's thermal impedance from 42 to 33.5 deg. C/W.

articleTitle: A III-V on silicon distributed-feedback laser based on exchange-Bragg coupling
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We present a distributed-feedback laser design that takes advantage of exchange Bragg coupling between a III-V stack and a Silicon-On-Insulator corrugated waveguide. Monomode laser emission is observed under optical pumping.

articleTitle: 200mm wafer scale III-V/SOI technology for all-optical network-on-chip and signal processing
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Integrated components, including microdisk lasers, photodetectors, and wavelength selective circuits, for optical network-on-chip and all-optical signal processing are presented using a complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor compatible III-V/silicon-on-insulator integration technology at 200mm wafer scale.

articleTitle: A low-voltage two-wavelength light emitter in standard CMOS technology
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A silicon light emitting device is fabricated in standard CMOS technology. It can emit visible light under reverse Zener breakdown and emit near infrared light under forward injection, both with low-voltage operation and enhanced efficiency.

Index Terms: Standard Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor Technology

articleTitle: Highly oriented ErxY2−xSiO5 crystalline thin films fabricated by pulsed laser deposition
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We propose layer-by-layer deposition approach to fabricate Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-x</sub>SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> crystalline thin films. Highly oriented Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-x</sub>SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> thin films with high crystallinity have been obtained by rapid thermal annealing (RTA) crystallization following pulsed-laser deposition (PLD).

articleTitle: High speed silicon optical modulator with self-aligned fabrication process
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Electronic and photonic devices formed using self-aligned processes are attractive for reducing performance variations and increasing yield. In this paper a novel high speed silicon optical modulator which has self-aligned pn junction formation is introduced.

articleTitle: Nonreciprocal Raman scattering in silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Raman-induced optical nonreciprocity in silicon photonic wires is demonstrated experimentally for the first time. Depending on crystallographic orientation, the ratio of counter-and co-propagating Raman efficiencies varies between 1.63 and 4.35.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional dispersive beam steerer fabricated on silicon-on-insulator
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A two-dimensional beam steerer on silicon-on-insulator is presented. Steering ranges of 5.5° in one direction and 50° in the other direction have been shown for a wavelength shift of 40nm. The largest measured sensitivity was 10.7° per nanometer wavelength shift.

articleTitle: Group index engineering in silicon corrugated waveguides
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We present experimental measurements of the group index in tailored silicon corrugated waveguides. Nearly constant group index as high as ng=14 ± 0.5 in a 13 nm range was measured in a 50 μm long waveguide.

articleTitle: Design of a T-shaped grating coupler used in silicon-based hybrid photodetector integration
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A T-shaped grating coupler used in silicon-based hybrid photodetector integration is designed. Power absorption efficiencies for TE and TM modes reach 72% and 81% respectively at 1550 nm with a detector length of 14 μm.

articleTitle: Nonreciprocal silicon waveguides and ring resonators with gyrotropic cladding
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Concepts are demonstrated for nonreciprocal Mach-Zehnder interferometers (MZIs) and ring resonators with polymer gyrotropic cladding. The isolation with -20 dB suppression is theoretically demonstrated in a 2μm radius ring resonator.

articleTitle: Upper limit for the amplifiable Stokes power in saturated silicon waveguide Raman amplifiers
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We derive upper limits for the amplifiable Stokes power in saturated silicon Raman amplifiers and the tolerable product of scattering-loss and FCA coefficients. Optimal pump conditions are given analytically and optimized amplifier designs are presented.

articleTitle: High-performance 1550 nm polymer-based LEDs on silicon using hybrid polyfluorene-based type-II heterojunctions
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report on the optoelectronic properties of hybrid polymer-based light-emitting diodes integrated on silicon chip. Using a hybrid polyfluorene-based type-II heterostructure host with PbS quantum dots, we achieved efficient room-temperature electroluminescence at telecommunication wavelengths.

articleTitle: High responsivity and low dark current operation of ultra-small InGaAs MSM photodetector integrated on Si waveguide
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrated a small footprint of 2 × 10 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> InGaAs MSM photodetector integrated on Si waveguide with high-efficiency and low dark current property. The detectors have responsivities of 0.94 A/W and the dark current of less than 20 nA, and are capable of 10 Gbps data rate.

articleTitle: High-speed silicon microring modulator with a 1 V drive voltage
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We present a silicon microring modulator with a 1 V drive voltage to achieve a 6.8 dB modulation depth at 10 Gbps. This drive voltage enables the modulator to be directly driven by CMOS electronics.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic properties of Si nanostructure based solar cells fabricated on quartz
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Solar cells with different silicon nanostructures have been fabricated on quartz wafers. A correlation between their photovoltaic properties and the conductivity was clearly found. The best results are achieved for amorphous silicon based nanostructures.

articleTitle: Optical manipulation and transport of microparticles on a silicon nitride microracetrack resonator add-drop device
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate optical manipulation of 1-μm-sized polystyrene particles on a silicon nitride microracetrack resonator add-drop device in an integrated optofluidic chip. We present the particle coupling and transport from the resonator to the drop-port waveguide.

articleTitle: Vertically coupled Si-based ring resonators for sensing applications
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report the design of a vertically coupled silicon-based ring resonator for sensing applications. Such devices can be realized with relaxed fabrication tolerances, and without the need for e-beam lithography.

articleTitle: Compact fully reconfigurable multi-stage RF photonic filters using high-Q silicon microdisk resonators
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We present a fully reconfigurable four-pole, four-zero SOI RF photonic filter with a 3dB bandwidth <;;5 GHz, out-of-band rejection >38 dB, FSR >600 GHz, and a compact size (<;;0.15 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) using high-Q resonator-based components.

articleTitle: A narrowband reconfigurable RF-photonic filter with efficient thermal tuning structures
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We present the design and fabrication of thermally-efficient tuning structures integrated into a narrowband reconfigurable radio-frequency-photonics filter using silicon-on-insulator waveguide optical delay lines. We are able to achieve IIR, FIR or mixed responses with <;; 100mW total tuning power.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis of surface-plasmon-enhanced light emission in fin silicon light-emitting diode
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We propose an ultra thin fin-shaped vertical silicon light-emitting diode with metal film deposition on each side for surface plasmonic resonance coupling, and numerically investigated its emission property.

articleTitle: Subwavelength grating: A new type of microphotonic waveguide and implementations to fiber-chip coupling, waveguide crossing and refractive index engineering
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate a new microphotonic waveguide principle based on subwavelength gratings. We also present several practical implementations of subwavelength waveguides, including a microphotonic fiber-chip coupler with a coupling loss as small as -0.3 dB, a waveguide crossover with an excess loss of 0.02dB/crossing and a PDL of <;;0.1 dB, and a new type of planar waveguide multiplexer.

articleTitle: Chip-to-chip optical wireless link feasibility using optical phased arrays on silicon-on-insulator
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: One- and two-dimensional integrated optical phased arrays (OPAs) on silicon-on-insulator have been fabricated and measured having directivities of more than 40dBi and steering ranges up to 10°. These OPAs would allow data rates of 100Mbps at distances up to 0.5m.

articleTitle: A selective area metal bonding method for Si photonics light sources
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A 1.55 μm hybrid InGaAsP-Si laser was fabricated by the selective area metal bonding method. Room temperature continuous lasing with a maximum output power of 0.45 mW is realized.

articleTitle: Photonic band-gap anomaly in SOI photonic-wire Bragg-grating filter
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We have systematically studied Bragg Grating Filters in Si photonic-wire waveguides. The reflected wavelength and the photonic band-gap were controlled over a wide range by changing the design parameters. We found a photonic band-gap anomaly on the numerical calculations and verified it on the experimental measurements. This phenomenon originates from the abnormal localized optical mode in 1-D photonic crystals.

articleTitle: High efficieny and long-term stability of nanocrystalline silicon based devices
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: High efficiency of silicon nanocrystal based devices is shown through energy-band gap engineering of the nanocrystal ensemble. By using bipolar tunneling, improved electrical and opto-electronic stabilities after long storage time and under aging experiments are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Monolithic Ge-on-Si lasers for integrated photonics
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report room temperature Ge-on-Si lasers with direct gap emission at 1590-1610 nm. Modeling of Ge/Si double heterojunction structures, which is supported by experimental results of Ge/Si LEDs, indicates the feasibility of electrically pumped lasers.

articleTitle: A monolithic integration optoelectronic integrated circuit in standard CMOS technology
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A monolithic integration optoelectronic integrated circuit (OEIC) is realized in standard CMOS technology. It consists of LED, waveguide, photodetector and receiver circuit. The LED-emitted light transmits through the waveguide and can be detected by photodetector.

articleTitle: A low VπL modulator with GHz bandwidth based on an electro-optic polymer-clad silicon slot waveguide
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate a near-infrared modulator with a bandwidth exceeding 1GHz, based on a silicon strip-loaded slot waveguide clad in a nonlinear electro-optic polymer. Our device achieves a V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</sub>L figure of merit of 0.8V-cm.

articleTitle: Strong Er emission from Er doped SiO2/nc-Si multilayers
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate strong Er emission from Er doped SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/nc-Si multilayer structures. Compared to reference samples, Er emission is enhanced and nc-Si emission is quenched, indicating energy transfer is the reason behind this enhancement.

articleTitle: A CMOS compatible 1×3 optical switch based on silicon on insulator
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A 1×3 optical switch is demonstrated utilizing the 0.8-μm standard CMOS technology. Extinction ratios higher than 21dB are obtained for three states. It is with low power consumption (~7.4mW) and switching time (~15.3ns).

articleTitle: Slow light with silicon photonic crystal ring microcavities
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate one-dimensional photonic crystal microring cavities coupled to straight waveguide in silicon-on-insulator. Near the photonic band edge, we measure large group index of ~14 by optimizing the evanescent coupling with different waveguides widths.

articleTitle: Ultra-highly sensitive digital optical sensor based on cascaded Si-nanowire rings
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Digital double-ring sensor based on silicon nanowires is demonstrated experimentally for the first time. An ultrahigh sensitivity δλ/δn up to 1.46 × 105 nm/RIU is achieved. And the detection limit is close to 2 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup>.

articleTitle: Ultrafast all-optical logic gates with silicon nanocrystal-based slot waveguides
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report an ultrafast (<;;40ps) all-optical XOR logic gate based on a silicon nanocrystal-based horizontal slot waveguide. The device consists of a Mach-Zehnder interferometer with three input ports, and is driven by ~200mW peak power.

articleTitle: Silicon waveguides and ring resonators at 5.5 µm
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We fabricate and characterize silicon waveguides and ring resonators around 5.5 μm on the Silicon-on-Sapphire (SOS) platform. The waveguide loss is 4.1 ± 0.7 dB/cm, and a Q value of 1.4k is achieved.

articleTitle: Demonstration of compact 2×2 multimode interference coupler on silicon nanomembrane
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We designed and fabricated a 2×2 tapered multimode interference coupler on silicon-on-insulator with dimensions of 12.88μm×3μm. The device keeps a 50/50 splitting ratio over a 50nm bandwidth. To our best knowledge this is the most compact 2×2 MMI demonstrated.

articleTitle: 1-Vpp 10-Gb/s operation of slow-light silicon Mach-Zehnder modulator in wavelength range of 1 nm
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We developed a slow-light silicon Mach-Zehnder modulator utilizing cascaded ring resonators. It operates at 10 Gb/s with driving voltage of 1 V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pp</sub> in a wavelength range of 1 nm without adjustment for the resonant wavelengths.

articleTitle: Coupled-resonator-induced-transparency concept for wavelength router applications
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We investigated the presence of high quality factor resonances due to Coupled Resonator Induced Transparency in complex sequences of coupled resonators devices, and proposed a new concept of wavelength router based on this effect.

articleTitle: Optical power stabilization using a germanium photodiode and a variable optical attenuator integrated on a silicon wire waveguide platform
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We have demonstrated fast optical power stabilization using a germanium photodiode and a silicon variable optical attenuator monolithically integrated on a compact silicon photonic platform. These integrated devices work synchronously with a ~100-MHz bandwidth. With an external electronic feedback circuit, the output power of the device is stabilized within an error of 3.7 dB for 20-dB input power variation. Feedback response time is about 100 ns.

articleTitle: High quality epitaxial Ge1−xSnx alloy films on Si with a Ge buffer by molecular beam epitaxy with combined sources
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Epitaxial Ge<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>Sn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> alloys were grown on Si(100) by MBE at low temperature with a Ge buffer layer. The Ge buffer was grown in the same system by two step method using GeH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> as gas source.

articleTitle: High speed electro-optic modulation in hybrid silicon on insulator slotted photonic crystal
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate GHz electro-optic modulation in a slotted silicon photonic crystal infiltrated with nonlinear optical polymer material.

articleTitle: Design of high-speed ultra-low Vπ slot waveguide modulators
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Slot waveguides allow joint confinement of the RF electrical and optical fields in a narrow slot and enable ultra-low driving voltage polymer based modulators with projected Vπ below 250 mV for 10 GHz devices.

articleTitle: Metal-oxide-silicon nanophotonics: An efficient integration of plasmonic nano-slots with silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate key elements of future plasmonic guided optics integrated with CMOS-compatible silicon photonics. Very efficient coupling is provided with metal nano-slot waveguides exhibiting unexpectedly low propagation losses and a broadband sub-50 nm optical confinement.

articleTitle: Visible photoluminescence and electroluminescence from a-SiNx:H/SiO2 multilayers with lateral carrier injection
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report photoluminescence (PL) and electroluminescence (EL) from a-SiN<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>:H/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> multi-layers. The PL peak and optical bandgap are tunable by varying the a-SiNx:H thickness. We report a lateral current injection method to enhance the EL efficiency of the multilayer structures.

articleTitle: Photon energy harvesting by rare-earth doping into blue-phosphorescent nanosilicon
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: The emission spectra of the blue Ph of SNSO are composed of 6 sub-bands exhibiting similar optical properties. The HWA treatment for rare-earth doped SNSO is very effective in activating the rare-earth emission in contrast to the conventional thermal annealing. Observed strong interaction between rare earth ions and the blue-emitting levels suggest the possibility of phosphorescent SNSO as a host matrix for efficient energy transfer. It may lead to enhancement of every emission line in the range from visible to infrared.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of ultrasmall Si-nanowire-based arrayed-waveguide grating (de)multiplexers with novel layouts
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: The measurement results for two types of ultrasmall arrayed-waveguide grating (AWG) (de)multiplexers with novel layouts based on silicon-on-insulator nanowires are presented. The ultrasmall AWG has 9-channel and the channel spacing is 400GHz.

articleTitle: Silicon nanophotonic devices based on periodic structures
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Periodic structures have been used extensively in optics and photonics. This paper is to report our work on manipulating optical propagation in the nanophotonics domain using silicon devices based on periodic structures.

articleTitle: Towards a low-power nanophotonic semiconductor amplifier heterogeneously integrated with SOI waveguides
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: In this paper we propose an optically pumped nanophotonic III-V semiconductor optical amplifier heterogeneously integrated on a silicon-on-insulator waveguide circuit through wafer bonding technology. 10μm long adiabatic tapers allow a full power transfer from the silicon waveguide layer to the III-V membrane. Low-power consumption is expected, given the high optical confinement in the 100nm thick III-V membrane waveguide, making it suitable for intra-chip optical interconnect networks. We report on the design and preliminary characterization of this novel type of high-index contrast nanophotonic device.

articleTitle: Electrically pumped random lasing from ZnO materials
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: In this presentation summary, the realization of electrically pumped random lasing from ZnO materials by means of metal-insulator-semiconductor structure is introduced. Moreover, the mechanism we have proposed for the electrically pumped random lasing is elucidated.

articleTitle: Design, fabrication and characterization of cascaded SOI rib waveguide microring resonators
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate a three-stage double channel cascaded microrings integrated with grating couplers based on SOI rib waveguide. The resonant frequencies were well matched at the drop-port and still splitting at the through-port which was considered to be due to fabrication variations. Flat-top and broadened bandwidth were achieved in the three-stage microring device.

articleTitle: Hybrid Si/III-V Fabry-Perot lasers based on adiabatic mode transformers
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report the first Si/III-V Fabry-Perot laser based on adiabatic mode transformers. The investigated device operates under quasi-continuous wave regime. The room temperature threshold current is 100 mA, the side mode suppression ratio is as high as 20dB, and the fiber-coupled output power is ~7mW.

articleTitle: Waveguide-integrated Germanium avalanche photodetector for low-noise and high-speed operation
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A waveguide-integrated Germanium avalanche photodetector with 10dB gain and excess-noise factor with k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub> below 0.2 was demonstrated. Gain-bandwidth-product of 350GHz was achieved at 3V. The single-crystalline Ge waveguide was integrated utilizing rapid melt growth technique.

articleTitle: Enhanced electroluminescence from nc-Si/SiO2 pillar arrays using nanosphere lithography
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Intensive electroluminescence could be observed from nc-Si/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> pillars. The electroluminescence intensity is increased by 30 times of magnitude compared to that of nc-Si/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> multilayers. The enhancement of EL can be attributed to the improved extraction efficiency of emission light and the high carrier-injection efficiency.

articleTitle: Feedback-controlled resonance and temporal response modulations in silicon microring resonators
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report feedback-controlled electro-optically tunable resonances and time delay in silicon microring resonators. We demonstrate tunable extinction ratio of up to 25 dB and time delay modulation from 90 ps to 19 ps.

articleTitle: Optical losses and cooperative upconversion in ion beam sputter-deposited ErxY2−xSiO2 waveguide amplifiers
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Factors leading to optical losses in ion-beam sputter deposited Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-x</sub>SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> waveguide amplifiers are investigated. By improving the film fabrication conditions and device design, lower scattering loss and cooperative upconversion coefficients are achieved.

articleTitle: Undertaking research in the field of silicon optical modulators in the framework of the Helios and UK silicon photonics projects
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report recent experimental results of research in different type of modulation in silicon developed in the framework of the UK project UK silicon photonics and European project HELIOS.

articleTitle: Polarization beam splitter based on a slot-groove grating
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A polarization beam splitter is proposed in this paper. Coupling efficiencies around 1550 nm for both TE and TM modes reach 50%. Extinction ratio is over 15 dB in the range of 1530-1630 nm.

articleTitle: 1.1 to 1.6 µm silicon light emitting diodes and optical gain
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report silicon LEDs showing light emission from 1.1 to 1.6 μm and demonstrate optical gain by incorporating optically active impurities. Nano-engineering enables room temperature operation. As one exemplar, we show that erbium, with local strain engineering provides useful optical emission and gain at 1.5 μm.

articleTitle: On the possibility of SiGeC superlattices having a broken-gap
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A CMOS-compatible SiGeC superlattice design is proposed that offers the possibility of generating a range of direct bandgaps smaller than Ge's, down to broken-gap provided that sufficient substitutional carbon content can be incorporated.

articleTitle: High Q microring demultiplexer filter for 60GHz microwave photonics applications
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A SOI microring demultiplexer filter is proposed for 60 GHz microwave photonics applications. A high Q factor of 33900 is experimentally demonstrated yielding to extinction ratios above 20dB but without degrading insertion losses which are kept below 3dB.

articleTitle: Emission-wavelength control using a mechanically stressed micro-beam structure: GaAs on Si-on-insulator beam
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Mechanically stressed micro-beam structures are proposed to control the emission wavelength for III-V compounds on Si-on-insulator wafers. Based on the calculations for GaAs, the tuning of emission wavelength and the locking from temperature fluctuations are demonstrated by controlling the applied stress.

articleTitle: Four-wave mixing in hydrogenated amorphous silicon waveguides at 1.55 µm
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report the observation of four-wave mixing in hydrogenated-amorphous-silicon waveguides. The maximum conversion efficiency is -19 dB for 4.0-mm-long hydrogenated-amorphous-silicon waveguide and 10-GHz repetition pump. The operation bandwidth is estimated to be over 60 nm.

articleTitle: Influence of electronic nonlinear process in silicon Raman wavelength converter
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Electronic nonlinear processes such as SPM, XPM and FWM cause dynamic phase shifting and enhance wavelength conversion efficiency in silicon Raman wavelength converter. Waveguide miniaturization to 4cm yields optimized conversion efficiency of -9.1dB.

articleTitle: Pump-induced optical nonlinearities in hydrogenated amorphous silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We characterize optical nonlinear properties in hydrogenated amorphous silicon (a-Si:H) wire waveguides at telecom wavelengths using a heterodyne pump-probe measurement. Optical nonlinear coefficients of the phase shift and absorption change are estimated and discussed.

articleTitle: Slow-light enhanced optical signal processing on a silicon chip at 640Gb/s
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate residual dispersion and optical signal-to-noise ratio monitoring of optical data via slow-light enhanced third harmonic generation in dispersion engineered 2D silicon photonic crystal waveguides, at data rates up to 640Gb/s.

articleTitle: Intervalley scattering and field screening in germanium/silicon-germanium quantum wells
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: The scattering time of electrons from the direct Γ to the indirect L valley in the conduction band of germanium/silicon-germanium quantum wells is measured to be ∼250 fs. Carrier field screening is also observed and modeled.

articleTitle: Integration of germanium quantum well structures on a silicon-on-insulator waveguide platform for optical modulator applications
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: An approach is proposed, analyzed, and demonstrated to integrate selectively grown germanium quantum well structures onto a silicon-on-insulator waveguide platform. This approach is promising for compact, ultra-low power optical waveguide modulators in optical interconnects.

articleTitle: Optical properties of ErxYb2−xSi2O7 thin film grown by RF magnetron sputtering method
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Er<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Yb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2−x</inf>Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf> thin films are synthesized on thermally oxidized n-Si substrates by RF-magnetron co-sputtering and subsequent annealing process. The photoluminescence properties of Er<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Yb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2−x</inf>Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf> thin films with 488 nm and 974 nm pumping lasers have been investigated.

articleTitle: Quantum control of phosphorus donor Rydberg states in silicon
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics

authors.preferredName: Alexander F. G. van der Meer

abstract: We demonstrate the first observation of a THz photon echo. We exploit the photon echo as an experimental tool to investigate the quantum coherence properties of excited donor Rydberg states of phosphorus in silicon.

articleTitle: High performance of silicon-based resonant-cavity-enhanced (RCE) photodetectors using sol-gel bonding
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report Si-based InGaAs RCE photodetectors. The detector without top mirror exhibits saturation output current higher than 19.8mA, and the responsivity is 0.33A/W. The full width at half maximum of the RCE photodetector is 4.8nm.

articleTitle: Direct-bandgap emission from hydrostatically tensile-strained Germanium nanocrystals
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report on the high room-temperature luminescence from Germanium nanocrystals synthesized by mechanical grinding. Transients and optical spectroscopy measurements are consistent with HRTEM and electron diffraction, suggesting high tensile strains favoring direct band-to-band transitions.

articleTitle: Photoluminescence from dislocations in silicon induced by irradiation of electron beams
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We induced dislocations controllably by using irradiation of electron beam. The dislocations induced by irradiation slipped though whole wafer and well-distributed at its slipping direction {111} <100> with a density highest to ∼1.3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup>. And dislocations related luminescence (DRL) peaks from D1 to D4 were observed in the irradiated silicon. This method may lead to the silicon based light emitting device with the compatibility of integrated circuit technology.

articleTitle: As-grown Ge pin photodiodes on Si with low dark current achieved by hydrogen desorption technique
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: As-grown Ge pin photodiodes on Si with a low dark current (4.6 × 10 - 2 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at -1 V) are achieved using a hydrogen desorption technique. This technique should enable the use of Ge in the CMOS backend process.

articleTitle: Dielectric grating reflectors with large focusing power
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We introduce a novel optical element, a dielectric resonance grating with a non-periodic pattern, able to reflect nearly 100% of incident light while shaping the reflected light phase front in an arbitrary way.

articleTitle: Effect of doping-induced defect concentration on the characteristics of Si-quantum-dot solar cells
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: In summary, p-type (or n-type) Si QDs/n-type (or p-type) crystalline-Si solar cells were successfully fabricated by ion beam sputtering and annealing, and their photovoltaic and luminescence properties were studied as functions of doping element and concentration. The active doping of B into the Si quantum dots was successfully proved to be due to the preferred diffusion of B into Si QDs by SIMS depth profiling analysis of B-doped Si02/B-doped Si multilayer film before and after annealing. The B-doped Si-QD solar cells showed close correlation of the photovoltaic properties with the NC/defect PL behaviors. Possible physical mechanisms will be discussed based on the doping-dependent experimental results for various doping elements.

articleTitle: MBE growth of high Sn-percentage GeSn alloys with a composition-dependent absorption-edge shift
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Low-temperature MBE growth of up to Ge<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.926</sub>Sn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.074</sub> alloys on lattice-matched In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.10</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.90</sub>As resulted in high-quality material as determined by AFM, TEM, and XRD. Samples show longer wavelength absorption-edge shifts with increasing Sn incorporation.

articleTitle: Study on Ge content of intermediate layer in growing relaxed Ge films on Si
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: The growth of relaxed Ge films was carried out in MBE equipment. We focused on the influence of Ge content of intermediate layer between LT and HT Ge films and achieved Ge film with threading dislocation density of 5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> and surface roughness of 1.5nm.

articleTitle: Birefringence characterization on SOI waveguide using optical low coherence interferometry
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: An optical low-coherence interferometry was utilized to characterize the birefringence on 5-μm thick silicon-on-insulator waveguides. The SMF-28 fiber was taken as a baseline to demonstrate 2.6×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> waveguide birefringence with 5-μm width and 2.5-μm etch depth.

articleTitle: Enhancement of light emission from silicon by a photonic crystal nanocavity and high-pressure water vapor annealing
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We propose and demonstrate the application of high-pressure water vapor annealing (HWA) to silicon photonic-crystal nanocavities for surface passivation. We find that HWA boosts light emission due to the reduction of surface recombination beyond simply using the cavity effect.

articleTitle: Silicon-based light emission in ultraviolet
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Efficient UV electroluminescence from Gd-doped SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gate oxide was reported with quantum efficiency larger than 5%. The efficiency and stability was improved by flash lamp annealing, co-doping with F<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> ions and K<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> ions.

articleTitle: Si-based polarization-extinguished waveguide couplers
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We presented polarization-extinguished waveguide couplers for silicon photonic wires. The structure is made by an asymmetric Si waveguide clad by SiC and SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. A preliminary result shows the polarization-extinction-ratio can be more than 17 dB.

articleTitle: The study on strain-induced second-harmonic generation in Si(111) surface and native SiO2/Si(111) interface
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: The mechanism of strain-induced second-harmonic generation (SISHG) has been studied and by this means the intrinsic strain build-in native Si/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> interface has been determined as a tensile with a magnitude of 3.07 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>.

articleTitle: Electrical and optical properties of III-V microdisk based LASERs fabricated on a CMOS pilot line
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Efficient sources are required for on chip optical networks in integrated circuits. Performances of the first full CMOS compatible III-V microdisk LASERs coupled to waveguides and fabricated on a 200 mm pilot line are investigated.

articleTitle: Silicon-based LED display array in standard CMOS technology
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Silicon-based light emitting diode (LED) display arrays, the static array and the dynamic array, are designed based on silicon p-n junction in standard 0.35-μm CMOS technology. The LED optical spectrum shows main peak at 760nm.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon enhanced electroluminescence of SiNx film based MIS device
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Electroluminescence of MIS devices consisted with an ITO/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/SiN<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>/Ag/p-Si/Al multilayer structure, as well as the multilayer without Ag, was investigated. The enhancement of EL intensity of MIS devices by introduce an Ag islands film was observed. Due to the existence of Ag islands film in the MIS devices of SiNx films, the injected current of MIS devices was increased and the extracted EL was also enhanced by the excitons-LSPs coupling.

articleTitle: Si ring optical modulator with multi-cascade p/n junctions
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Si ring resonators with multi-cascade p/n junctions have been proposed and its performance is simulated. The modulation takes a maximum at the carrier concentration of ~1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> when the propagation loss is 2 dB/cm.

articleTitle: Stimulated emission from silicon nanocrystals by two-photon excitation in CW operation
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: The superlinear emission of two-photon excited fluorescence from the silicon particles are observed under CW laser excitation, and the emission is attributed to stimulated emission. The silicon particles were produced by a ns pulse laser.

articleTitle: Silicon light emitting device based on rare earth oxide superlattice
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A scalable, monolithic approach for rare earth based materials would open new opportunities for silicon photonics. High quality rare earth oxides can be epitaxially grown on silicon substrates [1]. Crystalinity is key to making electrically pumped active media containing erbium (Er) as a major constituent. It is clear from previously published work in the field of silicon based photonics that incorporation of Er in a crystalline host allows active Er concentrations on the order of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">22</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> to be realized without segregation or secondary phase formation [2]. Best performance is found to be for a material in which the Er is diluted as this avoids the problems of concentration quenching of optical processes such as photoluminescence. The material of choice for this work is therefore (Gd<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>Er<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> in which Gd is the host material chosen because it has no optical transitions of its own in the wavelength range of interest. Figure {1a] shows the relationship between %Er and PL intensity, whilst figure [1b] shows the importance of the host rare earth comparing Yb with the final choice of Gd.

articleTitle: High-speed SOI microring modulator integrated with grating couplers
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate a high-speed SOI microring modulator integrated with grating couplers. Wafer-level measurements were set up for the device characterizations. 60 nm 3-dB coupling bandwidth and 10 Gb/s NRZ modulation are finally realized.

articleTitle: Simulation and demonstration of directed XOR logic gate using two cascaded microring resonators
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A directed logic architecture consisting of two silicon microring resonators which can perform XOR operation is proposed. Two electrical modulating signals applied to the microring resonators represent the operands of the logical operation. Bitwise XOR operation at 20 kbit/s is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Step waveguide design for efficient coupling to integrated Ge/Si avalanche photodetectors
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report a new step waveguide design for efficient coupling with integrated Ge/Si avalanche photodetectors, which offers high responsivity with a short horizontal absorption length.

articleTitle: Photoluminescence and electroluminescence from B-doped nanocrystal Si/SiO2 multilayers
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: B-doped nc-Si/SiO2 multilayers were formed using a PECVD system with subsequent thermal annealing. Room temperature photoluminescence and electroluminescence was investigated and compared with that of undoped nc-Si/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> samples.

articleTitle: SiGeC avalanche light emitters integrated with CMOS
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A CMOS-integrated SiGeC APD is presented, which under avalanche breakdown emits white light perpendicularly to the SiGeC layers. It can be used as an optical pump for devices such as Raman or Er-based lasers.

articleTitle: Optical activity and population inversion of Er doped in silicon-rich silicon nitride
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Optical activity and population inversion of Er doped in silicon-rich silicon nitride (SRSN) is investigated. Transmission measurements of SRSN waveguide shows that nearly all of doped Er is optically active even after high temperature anneals.

articleTitle: Packaging of SOI motherboards for highspeed all optical router applications
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: In this paper we present packaging developments around SOI high speed all optical router boards. We shall prove the feasibility of our approach by experimental figures for pigtailing power penalty.

articleTitle: Optical biosensing using horizontal slot microdisk resonator
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Biosensor using a horizontal slot microdisk resonator as a biosensor is demonstrated. Surface sensitivity of as high as 5.55 nm/nm is expected, and more than 9 nm shift upon sensing is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Ge/SiGe quantum wells structures for optical modulation
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Room-temperature Quantum-confined Stark effect (QCSE) in Ge/SiGe multiple quantum wells (MQWs) is demonstrated using optical transmission and photocurrent measurements. Effective absorption spectra of the heterostructures are presented as a function of electrical field.

articleTitle: Mechanical tensile strain engineering of Ge for gain achievement
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We show that the recombination energy of the direct band gap photoluminescence of germanium can be controlled by an external mechanical stress. The deformation is provided by an apparatus used for blister test. This strain leads to a significant change of the room temperature direct band gap recombination of germanium. An energy red-shift up to 60 meV is demonstrated for the room temperature photoluminescence of a thin germanium membrane (125 nm wavelength shift from 1535 to 1660 nm). This photoluminescence shift is correlated to the inplane tensile strain present in the film. A biaxial tensile strain larger than 0.6 % is achieved by this method. The wavelength shift is correlated to the predicted band gap shift as obtained from a 30 band k. p formalism. An excellent agreement is obtained between the experimental band gap shift and the theoretical one. This mechanical deformation allows to approach the direct band gap condition for germanium. We will discuss the possibility to achieve lasing with n-doped layers and the application of an external mechanical stress.

articleTitle: Luminescence of Tm3+ in dislocation engineered silicon substrates
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Photoluminescence at 1.2 to1.4 μm is demonstrated in dislocation engineered silicon substrates doped with Tm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> leading to the development of forward biased light emitting devices operating at a turn-on voltage of only 1 V.

articleTitle: Demonstration of high resolution SOI spectrometer with miniaturized disks
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: An ultra-compact 81-channel infrared spectrometer with high resolution (~ 0.6 nm) and low crosstalk (<;;-10dB) is demonstrated on the SOI platform using a large-scale array of miniaturized microdisk resonators with a large free-spectral range.

articleTitle: Low-temperature germanium ultra-high vacuum chemical vapor deposition for back-end photonic device integration
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: This work demonstrates single-crystal germanium deposited by ultra-high vacuum chemical vapor deposition (UHVCVD) on amorphous silicon (a-Si), with all processing performed at temperatures below 450°C. This material shows promise for the successful backend fabrication of photonic devices.

articleTitle: Preparation for Si/Se/Si sandwich structure on Si (001)
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A Si/Se/Si sandwich structure was prepared by ultra-high vacuum chemical vapor deposition. A red photoluminescence with narrow width was observed in the Si/Se/Si structure, which may be related to the band-to-band transition.

articleTitle: Silicon nanowire based radio-frequency spectrum analyser
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon nanowire based radio-frequency spectrum analyzer capable of characterizing ultrahigh speed optical data. Through measurement of 640GBit/s on-off-keyed data we show that although nonlinear loss affects device efficiency, free-carrier dispersion is negligible.

articleTitle: Crosstalk suppression in silicon nanowire arrayed waveguide grating by cascaded grating filter
publicationTitle: 7th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Cascaded grating filters are proposed to cut the side lobes of silicon nanowire arrayed waveguide grating introduced by fabrication error. Numerical simulation shows that the crosstalk level can be improved by about 15dB.
